text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While accompanying Fine Motion on an "inspection"
strolling through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Lively voices...
Could it be a festival?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!
A lottery draw!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It says "Anyone", Trainer!
Look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she handed over was the lottery ticket
she'd received as a bonus
when buying croquettes earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me over there,
might I join in as well?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes!
P-Please go right ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion enthusiastically
turned the raffle crank handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip~!
I'm so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Japanese hot springs really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's this thing called a public bathhouse, right?
I go there once in a while with friends!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We had bathtubs at the castle too, but...
I only learned the joy of relaxing in a long soak
after coming here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it's because... both at the dorms and in town,
I get to chat with so many people."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the hot springs are bound to be
such a wonderful experience too.
One day—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...I should give this ticket to you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's not as though it's an open-ended ticket, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I might not make it in time. ...Rather than letting it go to waste, I want you to use it."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
have fun♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seems to have completely
made peace with giving up the hot springs trip.
However—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll win the grand prize and give it to you.
Next time, I'll win the grand prize and give it to you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If a day like that ever comes,
I'll have you take me there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither is a promise guaranteed to be kept. Even so,
I believe the day will come when they are fulfilled—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Special grade" means it must taste simply wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's dig in right away♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~!?
Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"This Salisbury steak
is so delicious~!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I only gave it a quick reheat,
but it's so juicy!
They must be using traditional techniques.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
could you call the chef who prepared this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to chat about all kinds of things.
Our chef would probably learn a lot too, so if it's not too much trouble, I'd like to get them on a call as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Let us set up a dinner meeting, shall we, Captain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It turned into quite the big deal, but
Fine Motion seemed
thoroughly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~!
This looks big enough to cover an entire field, doesn't it!?
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like I can finish it all right away
Doesn't look like we can finish it all right away, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But
I'd like to enjoy it while it's still delicious.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—I know!
Let's have a potluck party with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Fine!
The carrot cake is done~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
...Mmm, smells lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
My carrot salad's done too~.
Cooking's actually pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that right♪
I decided to give it a try too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—I call it:
Carrot Ramen!
I'll prepare a freshly made bowl for you♪”

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful~!
Look at these shiny carrots!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Um, I am so sorry...
To think there's only one left.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why is that?
Quality is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That carrot is a treasured jewel,
grown with utmost care... isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I will gladly accept it♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: I-It's royal...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
âAh, I wonder if this counts
as snacking on the go too...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll split it in half, Trainer♪
Fufu, it's a showdown to see who finishes first!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aww, too bad!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, even losing is a learning experience! ♪
I'll be sure to put these tissues to good use.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Trainer, you're next.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And after that, the guards...
Oh, maybe I should invite some friends too?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Since we're here, I want to see you hit the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I guess so, huh?
No good after all.
